pll1d15c6-d1e3477.summary: Asks whether the Son was sent once or is sent often. If his mission is only the incarnation, it happened once; if often, there is another mission, perhaps the eternal generation, or some other kind.

pl-l1d15c6.summary: Asks whether the Son was sent only once or is sent often. If mission is only the incarnation, he was sent once; if often, there must be another mission besides the incarnation, either the eternal generation or something else.
